predecessor_evidence: ENERGY-37 DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO at ae1b56be031cec5d25a09c9df71486254192bb5d; one-pass energy acquisition lost to six-model committee and was ~13x slower than random+OMP in its synthetic task.
question: Does classical sparse-energy intervention selection deliver more verified causal intervention effects per unit of total policy CPU computation than strong inexpensive conventional selectors and learners on new causal mechanism families?
hypothesis: A one-pass sparse-energy uncertainty selector plus fully trained sparse-energy learner will outperform the strongest trained conventional/energy alternative on exact held causal-effect predictions and compute-adjusted yield, without losing baseline predictions under intervention context shifts.
status_at_freeze: UNRUN_PRIMARY; smoke source seed 99311 on 3 excluded source worlds independently audited 355 checks PASS before this prereg. No primary scoring executed.

source.source_kind: original SHA256 deterministic synthetic 8-bit action-consequence generator, no protected data, no paid API, no native Yggdrasil model

frozen_design.action_space: 8 binary intervention bits; 128 suffixes with two x0 contexts. Intervention is an externally set action vector. Clean causal response generated by a hidden signed majority of parity/AND terms, a context-specific parity switch, or a nonlinear gated parity/composition.
frozen_design.source_noise: Deterministic SHA256-keyed independent 10% label sign corruption on observed interventions. Clean causal labels only evaluator-side and unavailable to selector/learner.
frozen_design.partition: Hash-sort 128 7-bit suffixes each world. Train on first 48 x0=0 actions; 48 candidate x0=1 counterparts of old trained suffixes, choose exactly 12 before observing their labels; disjoint next 48 suffixes are evaluator-only paired old(x0=0) and new(x0=1) held actions; final 32 suffixes unused. No chosen/training action in held.
frozen_design.selector_method: Energy: one source gradient E=-y(w dot phi(x)), keep largest 12 coordinates, score 1/(1+abs(candidate margin)); OMP: trained 12-support conventional OMP uncertainty; ridge leverage: Woodbury exact ridge predictive variance with lambda=8; greedy Hamming diversity; SHA256-random. Nonrandom selectors greedily select 12, with at most +0.05 normalized diversity secondary score. None sees candidate outcomes before selection.
frozen_design.final_learner_capacity: 190 fixed 8-bit parity degree1..4 and AND2 features accessible to Energy/OMP/Ridge; sparse energy and OMP max12 active coefficients; Energy 32 epochs top8 gradient step 0.06 margin<1; OMP12 n_nonzero=12; Ridge alpha=3; decision tree depth8. All learners see same 60 acquired labels within each selector.
frozen_design.shuffled_negative: For onepass_energy selector only, deterministic sham shuffle all 60 actual observed consequences, refit same 32-epoch energy; compare exact signed causal-effect agreement.
frozen_design.null_control: Always predict no causal change (effect zero) across held paired contexts; count exact matches against actual held signed effect, include in strongest-control comparison.
frozen_design.runtime: Local Linux CPU Python 3.13.5 NumPy 2.3.5 scikit-learn 1.8.0; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1, no external API or GPU.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Single 54-world primary score; exactly one unchanged-source semantic replay and independent all-world refit audit. No hyperparameter tuning based on primary. CPU policy_total includes per-case synthetic world generation and same 48 old witness prep, acquisition selector time, final model fit and held-pair inference. Whole-experiment score wall measured separately. Third-party library startup/CI/GitHub excluded and must not be called system-wide runtime.

metric: Exact causal signed effect g(x0=1)-g(x0=0) in {-2,0,2} on 48 disjoint paired held interventions per world; 54x48=2592 held effects per arm, 2592 old and 2592 new predictions. Score strictly exact effect sign/value match, not just classification. Outcome null comparator is always zero.
controls: Onepass energy with shuffled training labels

frozen_gates.causal_effect_advantage: Onepass Energy+Energy must exceed max(all 19 other complete learned policy effect scores, no-effect null effect score) by >=3pp of 2592.
frozen_gates.new_context_advantage: Onepass Energy+Energy held x0=1 prediction count must exceed best of other 19 learned policies by >=2pp of 2592.
frozen_gates.old_context_retention: Onepass Energy+Energy old x0=0 prediction count must be within 1pp below best of other 19 policies on 2592 held old predictions.
frozen_gates.selector_vs_random: Onepass Energy+Energy correct signed effects must exceed Random+Energy by >=2pp of 2592.
frozen_gates.seed_stability: Onepass Energy+Energy must strictly exceed the strongest other learned policy on effect scores for at least 2 of 3 fresh source seeds.
frozen_gates.label_shuffled_negative: Onepass Energy+Energy must exceed its own label-shuffled energy control by >=5pp on 2592 exact effects.
frozen_gates.whole_policy_value_per_cpu: Aggregate onepass Energy+Energy exact effect correctness per sum(per-case source generation + selection + energy fit and held prediction CPU-time proxy wall seconds) must be >=1.5x Random+OMP12 value per identically defined component time. Report that timings exclude environment/setup/CI/GitHub and are not physically measured Joules or controlled whole-system compute.

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_GO only if all seven prospective gates true AND independent scorer audit PASS; still no SCIENTIFIC_PASS or promotion
classification_rules.mixed: Report individual gates and numbers without selective positive framing; reject if any failed
classification_rules.negative: DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO if any frozen gate fails; stop tuning on consumed seeds and preserve all cases
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID if missing prereg sequence, exact source/readback mismatch, leakage, unmatched action count, failed independent refit, or wrongly classified scores; don't claim scientific no-go from infrastructure failure.

independent_audit: Separately authored scalar hidden-source reconstruction and 5 selectors ×4 fully-fitted arms for each world; no original experiment import, 1:1 selected actions and witnessed labels, every held old/new/effect score and support matched; third-party sklearn conventional solvers shared. Audit runtime excluded from candidate policy cost but recorded separately.
external_knowledge: Causal intervention design cost-aware and information gain methods are documented in https://www.nature.com/articles/s42256-023-00719-0 and https://proceedings.mlr.press/v267/wang25bp.html. ENERGY-38 is not their implementation, but uses fully fitted conventional acquisition controls and explicit cost accounting.
